Markets.title: Rupee ends flat after hitting seven-month high as firmer dollar offsets inflows
Markets.sum: The Indian rupee closed almost flat after peaking at a seven-month high during early trading on Wednesday. Robust foreign investments in local stocks provided a boost, but a stronger dollar capped further gains. The dollar index rose by 0.2%, reaching its highest since April 2025 due to anticipations of accelerated rate hikes.

Markets.title: SpiceJet board approves up to Rs 5,500 crore fundraise amid operational challenges; stock hits 5% upper circuit
Markets.sum: SpiceJet's board of directors announced a fundraising plan to raise up to Rs 5,500 crore. The airline's shares have surged significantly, hitting the upper circuit for six consecutive sessions. Flight cancellations and operational disruptions have caused significant challenges for SpiceJet in recent days. The airline is focusing on rebuilding capacity and ensuring operational reliability going forward. The fundraising aims to strengthen its financial position and support fleet expansion efforts.

Markets.title: Govt weighs tax tweaks to boost stock trading, curb derivatives: Report

Hindi.sum: बहरीन इंस्टीट्यूट फॉर राइट्स एंड डेमोक्रेसी (बीआईआरडी) ने बताया कि मनामा की क्रिमिनल कोर्ट ने पांच अन्य लोगों को 15 साल जेल की सज़ा भी सुनाई है.
